shortDescription: Manage Protection Domain on Dell PowerFlex

options.name: hostname
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: is_active
options.description: Used to activate or deactivate the protection domain.

options.name: network_limits
options.description: Network bandwidth limit used by all SDS in protection domain.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number through which communication happens with PowerFlex host.

options.name: protection_domain_id
options.description: The ID of the protection domain. Except for create operation, all other operations can be performed using protection_domain_id. Mutually exclusive with I(protection_domain_name).

options.name: protection_domain_name
options.description: The name of the protection domain. Mandatory for create operation. It is unique across the PowerFlex array. Mutually exclusive with I(protection_domain_id).

options.name: protection_domain_new_name
options.description: Used to rename the protection domain.

options.name: rf_cache_limits
options.description: Used to set the RFcache parameters of the protection domain.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: username
options.description: The username of the PowerFlex host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether or not to validate SSL certificate. C(true) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. C(false) - Indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
